messages:
Priya: heads-up — new customer request to onboard Lumen-43B (open weights). They want private deployment, fp4 quant, and can commit to Dedicated if perf looks good. can we triage? :eyes:
Leo: do we have model artifacts or a hf/transformers link? tokenizer? vocab?
Priya: uploading link now — s3://cust-artifacts/lumen43b/v1/ (safetensors + tokenizer.json)
Priya: customer says sample prompt distribution is short chat turns, median 12 tokens, bursty spikes to 256. target p99 latency ~120ms at 8 tok generation (single-token step) and sustained 30 rps.
Nancy: quick checks: confirm rotary/rope variant and freq scaling. we've historically hit kv-cache layout mismatch on similar models. can you drop a small sample (first 10k params) or hf repo URL?
Priya: repo-style manifest in S3: model_card.md + manifests/schema.json (includes arch=LlamaLike, rotary=rotary_emb).
Tom: fp4 kernels are still experimental on our runtime. might need int8 fallback. what hardware do they want private on (A100 vs H100)? fp4 perf varies.
Priya: customer will run on H100 private nodes. they'd like fp4 to hit cost target.
Nancy: ok but for H100 we still need to validate kernel path. I'll run a quant smoke with this command and report errors:
```
python tools/quantize.py --input s3://cust-artifacts/lumen43b/v1/model.safetensors \
  --tokenizer s3://cust-artifacts/lumen43b/v1/tokenizer.json \
  --format safetensors --out /tmp/lumen43b-fp4 --mode fp4
```
Nancy: if that fails, fallback plan: int8-experimental + post-qat calibration.
eng-bot: CI: ingest-check triggered for lumen43b — download ok, checksum passed. starting quick-compat test.
eng-bot: CI: quick-compat finished — WARNING: kv-cache dim mismatch in layer_34, see /build/logs/1723456789/compat.log
Leo: kv-cache mismatch — likely rotary parameterization off by factor. we need sample decode with huggingface's config to repro. can someone run a minimal decode with the provided tokenizer and model?
Tom: i'll repro on a small VM. if it's the rotary mismatch we may need a tiny conversion patch (scale factor 1.0 vs 0.5).
Priya: proposed triage checklist (short):
  - confirm artifacts + checksums (done)
  - reproduce kv-cache decode locally (owner: Leo)
  - quant smoke fp4 on H100 (owner: Nancy)
  - perf microbench (p99/throughput) on dedicated config (owner: Tom)
  - eval suite (safety, tox, regen) with customer's prompt set (owner: Priya)
Priya: add risk items: kernel maturity for fp4, potential quality regression vs fp16 baseline, tokenizer edge-cases.
Nancy: I'll start quant smoke now. will post results and any stack trace here. :thumbsup:
Leo: I'll run decode, will attach a tiny reproducer in 15m.
Tom: prepping dedicated job template (task: lumen43b-h100-1x) and will include auto-fallback to int8 in policy.
Priya: thanks — if we get green on reproduce + quant smoke, we can move to onboarding checklist and schedule a canary in Private next week.
Nancy: quick note — if fp4 yields >1.5% perplexity loss on our eval set, we should hold and test int8/ptq.
Priya: agreed. tagging @Tom @Leo @Nancy for follow-ups.
Leo: reproduced kv mismatch, attaching stack snippet:
```
RuntimeError: kv_cache.size mismatch (expected 128, got 64) at layer_34
```
Tom: that aligns with rotary scaling. i'll try conversion patch and re-run.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: canary job lumen43b-h100-1x queued (blocked on QA sign-off).
Priya: incremental updates only here pls, keep other chatter out. we'll close triage once checklist items are green. :white_check_mark:
